{
  "name": "ruflo-browser",
  "description": "Session-as-skill browser automation: Playwright + RVF cognitive containers + ruvector trajectories + AgentDB selector memory + AIDefence PII/injection gates As a mod (ADR-445 pattern): a tighten-only tool guard, a local slash command, and a status file the console shows.",
  "version": "0.3.4",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "browser",
    "playwright",
    "testing",
    "automation",
    "scraping",
    "rvf",
    "replay",
    "trajectory",
    "agentdb",
    "aidefence",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tool guard",
      "description": "Refuse clearly harmful calls to this plugin's tools (tighten-only: it can only deny, never allow).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "strictUrls": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Strict URLs",
      "description": "Also refuse plain http URLs outside localhost.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ]
    }
  }
}
